description: A power supply, written by the maker as a joke and given to the people who donated: it provides fixed and variable voltages, and no module in Rack needs a power supply

params.text: Sets the voltage at the VAR output, -12V to 12V

outputs.text: A constant voltage set by the knob, anywhere from -12V to 12V

notes: no module in Rack draws power from a patch cable, so these outputs are constant voltages like any other and nothing has to be connected to them
